notes.content: DIVERSITY REQUIREMENT FOR CAL STATE LA GRADUATION

The articulation information in Assist.org not only shows a link to the admission requirements (aka our Major Specific Criteria webpage) but also Cal State LA graduation requirements that may be completed at the lower-division level, prior to transferring to the University. The diversity requirement is a graduation requirement , not an admission requirement. The diversity requirement may be completed prior to, or after, transferring to the University. For the Cal State LA degree, students will be required to complete two courses (six units) certified as diversity courses, at least one focusing on issues of race and ethnicity and their intersectionality with other social categories that structure inequality in society. These courses can be completed either at the lower-division or upper-division level from among courses satisfying GE requirements. Please view the General Education agreements on Assist.org for the lower-division courses that will meet the Diversity (d) and Race & Ethnicity (re) Requirements.

notes.content: The Bachelor of Arts degree in Environment and Urban Studies is designed to provide students with a comprehensive understanding of the world's physical and cultural environments and their interrelationship. The program provides a foundation in the theory and practice of contemporary geography, prioritizing the environmental and urban aspects of the discipline. Students will become proficient in both physical and social science research and methods with an emphasis on a variety of applied and technical skills that will enhance a student's career opportunities. The total number of units required for the Bachelor of Arts degree in Environment and Urban Studies is 120 units, of which 58-59 units are in the major. Consult with an advisor for the specific number of units required in all areas of the degree including GE courses and free electives.
